version: LOCK 87 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - The truth comes out
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

a.text: Idris is quiet for a moment. “People have been comparing what you told them. Truth comes out, traveller. It always does. A man who is known to lie isn't believed even when he tells the truth.”
